Residential Tenancy Agreement (fictional) - page 1 of 2 SAMPLE - FICTIONAL
Landlord: Alder & Finch Lettings (fictional)
Tenant: Maria Santos
Property: 14 Harbour Road, Northvale (fictional)
Monthly rent GBP 1,200.00
Deposit GBP 1,800.00
Start date 2026-12-01
Term 12 months (ending 2027-11-30)
1. Rent
The Tenant shall pay rent of GBP 1,200.00 per month in advance on the first day of each month.
2. Deposit
The Tenant shall pay a deposit of GBP 1,800.00, to be held in a fictional protection scheme and returned at the end of the term
less any agreed deductions.
3. Use of the property
The property is let as a private residence only. The Tenant shall keep it clean and in good repair and shall not sublet without
written consent.
4. Utilities
The Tenant is responsible for electricity, gas, water and council tax during the term.
5. Notice
Either party may end the tenancy after the fixed term by giving two months written notice.
This agreement is invented for software demonstration. It has no legal effect.

6. Access and inspection
The Landlord may inspect the property on 24 hours notice at reasonable times.
7. Termination for breach
If rent is more than 14 days overdue the Landlord may serve notice as provided in this fictional agreement.

Guarantor name Tomas Santos (fictional)
Relationship to tenant Brother (fictional)
Guarantor address 3 Example Lane, Northvale (fictional)
The Guarantor guarantees payment of rent by the Tenant under this agreement up to GBP 14,400.00.
